I talk with Casper about the stupid simple app marketing strategy that’s helping modern apps explode with mobile app growth. Casper breaks down how creator led startups are using creators as their primary app distribution strategy, turning audiences into powerful growth engines.

Casper explains how tiktok app marketing and short form content marketing are driving the next wave of viral app marketing. Instead of relying on paid ads, he shares how founders are building repeatable viral marketing frameworks that consistently generate attention and downloads.

During the conversation, Casper dives into how the creator economy business model is changing startup distribution. He explains why creator partnerships startups are becoming one of the most effective forms of app user acquisition strategy, and how many influencer marketing apps are structuring partnerships with creators to scale quickly.

We also discuss practical strategies behind social media marketing for apps, including how founders can build a scalable viral video marketing strategy using creators and content loops. Casper shares insights from working with app teams and how smart app founders marketing decisions can unlock serious traction.
